name: Center for Global Development
summary: A development policy think tank founded in 2001, based in Washington with a London arm, CGD Europe (set up in 2014). Its economists research and argue for changes in how rich countries and international agencies help poor ones: aid, development banks, global health financing, migration, trade and education. Its working group designed advance market commitments for vaccines; it shaped the Millennium Challenge Corporation, launched the International Initiative for Impact Evaluation (3ie) and argued for the development banks' recent capital reforms. CGD and CGD Europe spent US$23.9 million in 2025.

spending.source: https://www.cgdev.org/sites/default/files/CGD-2025-Consolidated-FS.pdf (consolidated statements of the Center for Global Development and CGD Europe, year ended 31 December 2025, p. 8: program services US$19,116,320 of US$23,948,115 total expenses)

lines.label: Policy research, data, convening and advocacy on development (global health, development finance, migration, education, US and European development policy)
lines.source: https://www.cgdev.org/sites/default/files/CGD-2025-Consolidated-FS.pdf (p. 8, 2025): program services US$19,116,320, the accounts' one programme line; one model covers it as three branches (the pneumococcal advance market commitment, the development banks' capital reforms, the Millennium Challenge Corporation's design) with the rest of the work as a share of them.
